# HeadStart image sources and notices

World, companion and foreground foliage are original generated artwork. See [asset prompts](../ASSET-PROMPTS.md).

Game preview originals are copied without changing their bytes. The UI scales them and uses a cover crop in cards. They are historical examples, not captures of the indexed source revisions. Attribution and source evidence are available from each card’s Source & image link.

See [full game-preview notices](provenance/NOTICES.md) and [preserved license texts](provenance/licenses/).
